fact: The National Registration (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 were made on 23 July 2026 by the Homeland Security Minister under powers in the National Registration Act, which the NRB runs for National ID; the report gives the Act's number and year nowhere, and the instrument is an Act of parliament with regulations made under it.

CAJ News reports a stakeholders' consultative meeting, just concluded, to review the existing National Registration Act (an Act of parliament, number and year not given) under the Digital Malawi Acceleration Project, as the registration bureau reviews registration laws; the document gives no date for the meeting, so the published date is used.
